```{r pipeline-wis}
# Per-horizon evaluation start dates based on first forecast with ground truth
# Reference date 2025-11-15 produces:
#   h1 (CDC h0) target_end_date = 2025-11-22
#   h2 (CDC h1) target_end_date = 2025-11-29
#   h3 (CDC h2) target_end_date = 2025-12-06
#   h4 (CDC h3) target_end_date = 2025-12-13
EVAL_START_BY_HORIZON <- c(
  `1` = as.Date('2025-11-22'),
  `2` = as.Date('2025-11-29'),
  `3` = as.Date('2025-12-06'),
  `4` = as.Date('2025-12-13')
)

# Helper: latest file in a directory by pattern
latest_file <- function(dir, pattern) {
  files <- list.files(dir, pattern = pattern, full.names = TRUE)
  if (length(files) == 0) return(NA_character_)
  files[order(files)][length(files)]
}

# Load latest actuals
actual_path <- latest_file('../data/imputed_sets', '^imputed_and_stitched_hosp_\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}\\.csv$')
stopifnot(!is.na(actual_path))
actual_raw <- read_csv(actual_path, show_col_types = FALSE)

# Map location_name -> FIPS
location_to_fips <- c(
  'Alabama'='01','Alaska'='02','Arizona'='04','Arkansas'='05','California'='06','Colorado'='08','Connecticut'='09','Delaware'='10',
  'District of Columbia'='11','Florida'='12','Georgia'='13','Hawaii'='15','Idaho'='16','Illinois'='17','Indiana'='18','Iowa'='19',
  'Kansas'='20','Kentucky'='21','Louisiana'='22','Maine'='23','Maryland'='24','Massachusetts'='25','Michigan'='26','Minnesota'='27',
  'Mississippi'='28','Missouri'='29','Montana'='30','Nebraska'='31','Nevada'='32','New Hampshire'='33','New Jersey'='34','New Mexico'='35',
  'New York'='36','North Carolina'='37','North Dakota'='38','Ohio'='39','Oklahoma'='40','Oregon'='41','Pennsylvania'='42','Puerto Rico'='72',
  'Rhode Island'='44','South Carolina'='45','South Dakota'='46','Tennessee'='47','Texas'='48','Utah'='49','Vermont'='50','Virginia'='51',
  'Washington'='53','West Virginia'='54','Wisconsin'='55','Wyoming'='56','US'='US'
)

actual_data <- actual_raw %>%
  transmute(location = location_to_fips[location_name], date = as.Date(date), actual_value = total_hosp) %>%
  filter(!is.na(location))

# Load model retrospective files for h=1..4
load_model <- function(path, model_name, h){
  if (!file.exists(path)) return(NULL)
  df <- read_csv(path, show_col_types = FALSE)
  df$model <- model_name
  df$h <- h
  df <- df %>% mutate(reference_date = as.Date(reference_date), target_end_date = as.Date(target_end_date))
  df
}

all_models <- list()
for (h in 1:4) {
  baseline <- load_model(sprintf('../forecasts/retrospective/Flusight-baseline_h%d_forecasts.csv', h), 'FluSight-baseline', h)
  arima <- load_model(sprintf('../forecasts/retrospective/arima/ARIMA_h%d_forecasts.csv', h), 'ARIMA', h)
  lgbm_blended <- load_model(sprintf('../forecasts/retrospective/lgbm_blended/LGBM-blended_h%d_forecasts.csv', h), 'LGBM_blended', h)
  lgbm_bounded <- load_model(sprintf('../forecasts/retrospective/lgbm_enhanced_t10_bounded/TwoStage-FrozenMu_h%d_forecasts.csv', h), 'LGBM_bounded', h)
  svm <- load_model(sprintf('../forecasts/retrospective/svm_t100/svm_retrospective_h%d.csv', h), 'SVM', h)
  dfs <- list(baseline, arima, lgbm_blended, lgbm_bounded, svm)

  # Load bounded-wide variants 1-5
  for (v in 1:5) {
    lgbm_bounded_wide_v <- load_model(
      sprintf('../forecasts/retrospective/lgbm_enhanced_t10_bounded_wide_%d/TwoStage-FrozenMu_h%d_forecasts.csv', v, h),
      sprintf('LGBM_bounded_wide_%d', v), h)
    if (!is.null(lgbm_bounded_wide_v)) {
      dfs <- c(dfs, list(lgbm_bounded_wide_v))
    }
  }

  dfs <- dfs[!sapply(dfs, is.null)]
  if (length(dfs) > 0) all_models[[paste0('h', h)]] <- bind_rows(dfs)
}

# Load AdaptiveEnsemble from multiple retrospective files
# Ensemble uses CDC horizon convention (0-3), we need to convert to internal (1-4)
ensemble_files <- list.files('../forecasts/retrospective/ensemble', pattern = '^AdaptiveEnsemble_retrospective_.*\\.csv$', full.names = TRUE)
if (length(ensemble_files) > 0) {
  ensemble_list <- lapply(ensemble_files, function(f) {
    df <- read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE)
    df <- df %>%
      filter(output_type == 'quantile') %>%
      mutate(
        model = 'AdaptiveEnsemble',
        h = as.integer(horizon) + 1,  # Convert CDC horizon (0-3) to internal (1-4)
        reference_date = as.Date(reference_date),
        target_end_date = as.Date(target_end_date)
      )
    df
  })
  ensemble_all <- bind_rows(ensemble_list)

  # Add ensemble to all_models by horizon
  for (h in 1:4) {
    ens_h <- ensemble_all %>% filter(h == !!h)
    if (nrow(ens_h) > 0) {
      if (paste0('h', h) %in% names(all_models)) {
        all_models[[paste0('h', h)]] <- bind_rows(all_models[[paste0('h', h)]], ens_h)
      } else {
        all_models[[paste0('h', h)]] <- ens_h
      }
    }
  }
}

stopifnot(length(all_models) > 0)
ret_all <- bind_rows(all_models)

# WIS function (standard scale, matching scoringutils/hubEvals)
calculate_wis_single <- function(qvals, qlevels, actual_value){
  if (length(actual_value) == 0 || all(is.na(actual_value))) return(NA_real_)
  qv <- as.numeric(qvals)
  ql <- as.numeric(qlevels)
  y <- as.numeric(actual_value)[1]
  if (!is.finite(y)) return(NA_real_)
  keep <- is.finite(qv) & is.finite(ql)
  qv <- qv[keep]; ql <- ql[keep]
  if (length(qv) == 0 || length(ql) == 0) return(NA_real_)

  # Get unique alpha levels (for symmetric intervals)
  alphas <- unique(c(ql[ql <= 0.5], 1 - ql[ql > 0.5]))
  alphas <- alphas[is.finite(alphas) & alphas > 0]
  if (length(alphas) == 0) return(NA_real_)

  scores <- sapply(alphas, function(a){
    li <- suppressWarnings(which.min(abs(ql - a)))
    ui <- suppressWarnings(which.min(abs(ql - (1 - a))))
    if (length(li) == 0 || length(ui) == 0 || is.na(li) || is.na(ui)) return(NA_real_)
    L <- qv[li]; U <- qv[ui]
    if (!is.finite(L) || !is.finite(U)) return(NA_real_)
    width <- U - L
    pen <- if (y < L) (2/a) * (L - y) else if (y > U) (2/a) * (y - U) else 0
    if (is.finite(width) && is.finite(pen)) (a/2) * (width + pen) else NA_real_
  })
  if (all(is.na(scores))) NA_real_ else sum(scores, na.rm = TRUE)
}

# Compute WIS per horizon with horizon-specific start dates
wis_scores_all <- list()
for (h in sort(unique(ret_all$h))) {
  eval_start_h <- EVAL_START_BY_HORIZON[as.character(h)]

  dfh <- ret_all %>%
    filter(h == !!h, output_type == 'quantile', as.Date(target_end_date) >= eval_start_h) %>%
    mutate(output_type_id = as.numeric(output_type_id))
  if (nrow(dfh) == 0) next

  wis_scores <- dfh %>%
    group_by(h, model, reference_date, target_end_date, location) %>%
    summarise(quantile_values = list(value), quantile_levels = list(output_type_id), .groups = 'drop') %>%
    left_join(actual_data, by = c('target_end_date' = 'date', 'location' = 'location')) %>%
    filter(!is.na(actual_value)) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(interval_score = calculate_wis_single(unlist(quantile_values), unlist(quantile_levels), actual_value)) %>%
    ungroup()
  wis_scores_all[[paste0('h', h)]] <- wis_scores
}

wis_scores_all_df <- bind_rows(wis_scores_all) %>% filter(!(location %in% c('72','US')))

# Ensure identical date/location sets across models within each horizon
wis_common_list <- list()
for (hh in sort(unique(wis_scores_all_df$h))) {
  sub <- wis_scores_all_df %>% filter(h == !!hh)
  models_present <- unique(sub$model)
  keys <- sub %>%
    group_by(location, target_end_date) %>%
    summarise(n_models = n_distinct(model), .groups='drop') %>%
    filter(n_models == length(models_present)) %>%
    select(location, target_end_date)
  sub_common <- sub %>% inner_join(keys, by=c('location','target_end_date'))
  wis_common_list[[paste0('h', hh)]] <- sub_common
}

wis_scores_common <- bind_rows(wis_common_list)

cat("\nEVALUATION INFO:\n")
cat("Per-horizon evaluation start dates:\n")
for (hh in names(EVAL_START_BY_HORIZON)) {
  cat(sprintf("  Horizon %s: target_end_date >= %s\n", hh, as.character(EVAL_START_BY_HORIZON[hh])))
}
cat("\nCommon evaluation set date range per horizon:\n")
print(wis_scores_common %>% group_by(h) %>% summarise(start=min(target_end_date), end=max(target_end_date), n_dates=n_distinct(target_end_date)))

# Per-horizon geometric mean WIS and relative WIS
wis_by_model <- wis_scores_common %>%
  group_by(h, model, location) %>%
  summarise(mean_wis_loc = mean(interval_score, na.rm=TRUE), .groups='drop') %>%
  group_by(h, model) %>%
  summarise(geometric_mean_wis = exp(mean(log(mean_wis_loc), na.rm=TRUE)), .groups='drop')

per_horizon_summary <- wis_by_model %>%
  group_by(h) %>%
  mutate(baseline_gmw = dplyr::first(geometric_mean_wis[model == 'FluSight-baseline'])) %>%
  mutate(relative_wis = ifelse(!is.na(baseline_gmw) & baseline_gmw > 0,
                               geometric_mean_wis / baseline_gmw,
                               NA_real_)) %>%
  select(-baseline_gmw) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(h, is.na(relative_wis), relative_wis)

cat("\n\nPER-HORIZON GEOMETRIC MEAN WIS AND RELATIVE WIS:\n\n")
print(knitr::kable(per_horizon_summary, digits = 4))

# Combined across horizons - only include models with all available horizons
# First, find how many horizons have data
n_horizons_with_data <- n_distinct(wis_scores_common$h)

models_with_all_horizons <- wis_scores_common %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  summarise(n_horizons = n_distinct(h), .groups='drop') %>%
  filter(n_horizons == n_horizons_with_data) %>%
  pull(model)

combined_by_model <- wis_scores_common %>%
  filter(model %in% models_with_all_horizons) %>%
  group_by(model, location) %>%
  summarise(mean_wis_loc = mean(interval_score, na.rm=TRUE), .groups='drop') %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  summarise(geometric_mean_wis = exp(mean(log(mean_wis_loc), na.rm=TRUE)), .groups='drop')

combined_summary <- combined_by_model %>%
  mutate(baseline_gmw = dplyr::first(geometric_mean_wis[model == 'FluSight-baseline'])) %>%
  mutate(relative_wis = ifelse(!is.na(baseline_gmw) & baseline_gmw > 0,
                               geometric_mean_wis / baseline_gmw,
                               NA_real_)) %>%
  select(-baseline_gmw) %>%
  arrange(is.na(relative_wis), relative_wis)

cat(sprintf("\n\nCOMBINED GEOMETRIC MEAN WIS AND RELATIVE WIS (Horizons 1-%d):\n\n", n_horizons_with_data))
cat(sprintf("Note: Only models with data for all %d horizons with ground truth are included.\n", n_horizons_with_data))
print(knitr::kable(combined_summary, digits = 4))
```
